scope: N02 complete X0 application using frozen X035 route/setup adapter; host/register model and structural ABI, no physical pin/clock/IRQ proof
preparation: explicit cold/quiescent declaration; no automatic prepare in start
admission: Manager claims peripheral/pins first, then Setup::ready rechecks nominal PCLK, gates, idle, route/pins and debug release
debug: caller/owner already released debug pins; adapter must not disable debugger
rollback: failed setup may retain its own lease until explicit abandon with a quiescent declaration
retained_result: reprepare and new owner may run after backend reap, before old application take
boolean_baseline: same existing direct/event adapter with an externally configured board model and boolean pin declaration
implementation_note: new start wrapper reuses existing poll/take/cancel/event code; inherited boolean pins field retained but unused in prepared mode
abi_memory_profile: CH32X035C8T6 only; F7 labels test pin/package guard code under this structural map, not F7 physical fit
abi_matrix: empty plus boolean family/mode/used-unused plus all package/route/family/mode/used-unused; both LTO settings
not_verified: human review and final API adoption
